request.style: English, children's song, playful male lead with kids choir, acoustic guitar, xylophone, toy piano, claps, tuba bass, bouncy and silly, 112 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the desert, hot and dry
Hungry tummies, hear them cry
Moses prayed and God replied
I'll feed you from the sky

[Verse]
In the morning, look around
White and flaky on the ground
Fine as frost on the ground
What is this that we have found

[Chorus]
What is it, what is it
Nobody knows
What is it, what is it
Everybody goes
It is the bread the LORD has given you to eat
Thank you, God, for something sweet

[Verse]
Take enough for just one day
Don't you try to stash away
Every morning, rain or shine
God gives bread, and right on time

[Chorus]
What is it, what is it
Nobody knows
What is it, what is it
Everybody goes
It is the bread the LORD has given you to eat
Thank you, God, for something sweet

[Outro]
Manna, manna, every day
Thank you, God, we shout hooray
